parsed.paper: Resurrection Views Across the Theological Spectrum (Pt. 2) - Gary Habermas

core_relation.sentence: The persuasiveness of the resurrection case depends on the convergence of multiple independent lines of evidence—early pre-Pauline creeds, the admitted eyewitness status of Paul, the bodily-resurrection testimony of both friendly and critical scholars, and the historical reliability of the sources—such that removing any one line weakens but does not by itself destroy the cumulative argument.
core_relation.quote: What keeps the creeds from being expanded until they become myth? And they're not really the words of the eyewitnesses. Critics admit that Paul was an eyewitness. They admit that Paul's their hero, good guy. They like them. And they always grant those se first the seven books. [S401-S407]

product_test.quote: So, if it if it can be taken either way in context, why don't you find five more places where I said it the the way you're blaming me with? Instead of using one cloudy one, why don't you give me five more clear ones? [S317-S318]
product_test.reason: Habermas's argument is explicitly cumulative: multiple early creeds, multiple sources, multiple scholars across the spectrum. He repeatedly asks for 'five more' instances rather than treating a single counterexample as fatal. The conclusion (resurrection is historically knowable) would be weakened but not zeroed by losing one line of evidence. The paper shows no single ingredient whose absence collapses the entire case.

slots.plays_role: External negentropy influx — the outside source that keeps the coherence of the resurrection testimony from dissipating into myth. For Habermas, this is the pre-Pauline creedal tradition that enters the historical record from outside Paul's own authorship and before his conversion.
slots.quote: They said that creed or its component parts was already in existence before Paul took his walk to Damascus. [S388]

slots.plays_role: Alignment — the coupling between the researcher and the evidence. Habermas aligns with the data by reading critics and believers equally, refusing to prejudge who is a Christian.
slots.quote: I have no right to label somebody a Christian or a non-Christian. [S015]

slots.plays_role: Signal fidelity — whether the historical truth survives transmission through the noise of scholarly distortion and myth. The early creeds are the signal that must not be corrupted.
slots.quote: What keeps the creeds from being expanded until they become myth? And they're not really the words of the eyewitnesses. [S401-S402]

slots.plays_role: Effective entropy — the noise that lowers coherence: the gap between the resurrection event and the written sources, which critics claim allows myth to develop.
slots.quote: 33 to 48 is only 15 years. That's really But if you go with me with I'd say 30 to 50, that's 20 years. That's earlier than Mark, earlier in all the gospels. [S350-S352]

slots.plays_role: Temporal integration — the accumulation of historical consequence over time. The shorter the gap between event and creed, the stronger the case; time turns possibility into accumulated evidence.
slots.quote: 33 to 48 is only 15 years. That's really But if you go with me with I'd say 30 to 50, that's 20 years. That's earlier than Mark, earlier in all the gospels. [S350-S352]

slots.plays_role: Compression — ordered meaning compresses and noise does not. The creeds are compressed summaries of the earliest eyewitness testimony; the minimal facts are a compression of the scholarly consensus.
slots.quote: I often talk about the creeds. I have a lot I have a lot of stuff on the creeds. I often count the creeds. [S341-S343]

slots.plays_role: Phase transition — a threshold that changes state, not just degree. The conversion of a skeptic or the shift of a scholar's view (e.g., Jimmy Dunn moving right, Tony Flew's letter) is treated as a qualitative change.
slots.quote: Read these six pages. It looks like he's converting to Christianity. [S049-S050]

slots.plays_role: Superposition — open possibility stays unresolved until actualized. Habermas refuses to resolve the question of who is a Christian or where a person stands before God, leaving it open.
slots.quote: I don't ever want to say whether I think so and so is a Christian or not a Christian because you're probably asking them questions about their deepest heart. [S096-S097]

slots.plays_role: Non-local correlation — related systems are no longer independent. The resurrection appearances create a correlation between Jesus and the disciples, and between the early church and later believers.
slots.quote: I believe that the disciples saw Jesus and that he saw them and next Easter will find me in church. [S201]

slots.plays_role: Integration — the local integrator inside the product. Habermas himself is the integrator, the scholar who gathers and weighs the spectrum of views into a single cumulative case.
slots.quote: I wrote the book. If you want to write it, you go write one. But I can tell you what I'm what I'm doing. [S307-S309]

breaks: The product test is additive, not multiplicative: Habermas treats the evidence as cumulative, so no single factor's absence collapses the case.
The paper is a conversational interview, not a formal argument, so the 'core relation' is implicit and distributed across many remarks rather than stated in one place.
G (external negentropy influx) is stretched: the early creed is an external historical source, but the paper does not frame it as an energizing influx that sustains coherence.
S_eff (effective entropy) is stretched: the time gap functions as a source of doubt, but the paper does not use an entropy framework.
Q (superposition) is stretched: the refusal to judge who is a Christian is an epistemic humility, not a physical superposition of states.
F (non-local correlation) is stretched: the relational claim is theological, not a physical non-local correlation.
extra_factors: The principle of charity (S095) — a methodological virtue that Habermas explicitly calls for, which does not map cleanly to any single slot.
The 'minimal facts' method (S492) — a specific historiographical approach that functions as a meta-factor, not a slot.
The 'one comment book reviews' section (S449) — a humanizing factor that adds color but no slot.
parsed.one_line: The paper's cumulative historical case for the resurrection is only loosely analogous to the master equation: it has clear temporal-integration, signal-fidelity, and integration factors, but the product test is additive and most other slots are stretched or absent.
